description: Full agent stack: Qwen Code agent home (qwen-home/) + Python mini-app platform (gateway consuming the agentboom-sdk package) + Docker deployment.

notes.managed: Patterns are fnmatch-style against agent-relative paths ('*' also matches '/'). Base skills copied into .qwen-docker/skills/ are always managed regardless of these patterns. The runtime SDK is NOT copied anymore — it is installed as the agentboom-sdk package via platform/requirements.txt.
notes.user_owned: Everything else (AGENTS.md, compose, Dockerfiles, miniapps, migrations 002_+) belongs to the agent from init onwards.
